question: _______ has been re-elected as the President of International Solar Alliance in October 2022.
solution:
​The correct answer is** India**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• India and France have been re-elected as President and Co-President of the International Solar Alliance (ISA).
 
• Union Power & Renewable Energy Minister R K Singh has been re-elected as the President of the International Solar Alliance while France Minister of State for Development Chrysoula Zacharopoulou has been re-elected as Co-President.
 
• ISA's 5th Assembly began in New Delhi on 17th Oct 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The International Solar Alliance strives to develop and deploy cost-effective and transformational energy solutions powered by the sun to help member countries develop low-carbon growth trajectories.
 
• It particularly focuses on delivering impact in countries categorized as Least Developed Countries (LDCs) and the Small Island Developing States (SIDS). 
 
• Currently, the ISA has 9 comprehensive programs, each focusing on a distinct application.
 
• The ISA was conceived as a joint effort by India and France to mobilize efforts against climate change through deployment of solar energy solutions.
 
• It was conceptualized on the sidelines of the 21st Conference of Parties (COP21) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) held in Paris in 2015.
 
• With the amendment of its Framework Agreement in 2020, all member states of the United Nations are now eligible to join the ISA.
 
• ISA HQ: Gurugram
